verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Bun serves an llms.txt at bun.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its docs as markdown links, plus a markdown docs root at bun.com/docs.md. Individual doc pages are also served as .md URLs (e.g. docs/pm/cli/add.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, and evidence of fuller agent-oriented guidance (e.g. an llms-full.txt or agent usage notes).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://bun.com/llms.txt # Bun
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://bun.com/docs.md # Welcome to Bun
